prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Baytown, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1350; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference. I'm the driver of the vehicle that was struck.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?

A: It was at a four-way intersection in Baytown, Texas. I was going through on a green light, heading straight across.

Q: What happened as you entered the intersection?

A: A pickup coming from my right ran the red light. It hit the driver's side of my car, right in the middle of the door. The impact spun my car partway around.

Q: Were you able to see the pickup before the collision?

A: Not really. I saw it a split second before it hit me. I tried to brake, but there wasn't time.

Q: Did you have any injuries at the scene?

A: My left knee hit the dashboard and the steering column area. It hurt right away, and it swelled up within an hour or so.

Q: Did you seek medical care?

A: Yes. The paramedics checked me at the scene, and I went to the emergency room later that day. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic doctor.

Q: Are you still having symptoms?

A: Yes. The knee is stiff in the morning, and I have trouble going up stairs. I'm doing physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Just that I was following the traffic rules and I believe the other driver should be responsible for this.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
